Mysterious Treasures

Released August 1, 2007 · 124 cards

Mysterious Treasures is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on August 1, 2007. Its main set has 123 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (124 in total). It includes 111 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

21 illustrators worked on Mysterious Treasures. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (18), Kazuyuki Kano (11), Kagemaru Himeno (10), Masakazu Fukuda (10), Ryo Ueda (10), Kouki Saitou (9), Midori Harada (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (9).
